description: This file contains the definition of the Marshaler class, which handles marshaling and unmarshaling between JSON, PHP arrays, and DynamoDB item formats, specifically for AWS DynamoDB SDK.

classes.name: Marshaler
classes.description: A class for marshaling and unmarshaling data between PHP and DynamoDB item formats.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes marshaler with options, merging provided options with defaults.

methods.name: binary
methods.description: Creates a DynamoDB BinaryValue object for binary data.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Creates a NumberValue object to represent numeric data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Creates a SetValue object for sets of strings, numbers, or binaries.

methods.name: marshalJson
methods.description: Marshals a JSON string into a DynamoDB item array.

methods.name: marshalItem
methods.description: Marshals a PHP array or object into a DynamoDB item array.

methods.name: marshalValue
methods.description: Recursively marshals a PHP value into DynamoDB attribute value format.

methods.name: unmarshalJson
methods.description: Converts a DynamoDB item array into a JSON string.

methods.name: unmarshalItem
methods.description: Converts a DynamoDB item array into a PHP array or object.

methods.name: unmarshalValue
methods.description: Recursively unmarshals a DynamoDB attribute value into a PHP scalar, array, or object.

methods.name: handleInvalid
methods.description: Handles invalid values during marshaling based on configuration options.
